newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen and UNDP sign environmental protection deal.
newsitem.headline: Yemen and UNDP sign environmental protection deal.

text.p: Yemen and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) on Sunday signed a deal to launch an environmental project worth $11.74 million, Yemeni television reported.
It said the UNDP's contribution "reached $6.05 million while the (U.N.'s) World Environment Facilities Fund contributed $5.24 million".
It said the Yemeni government "is contributing $450,000 in cash and 20 million rials ($160,000) in kind". It did not elaborate.

The project seeks to strengthen environmental programmes in a number of governmental institutions, protect natural resources, promote biological diversity and fight desertification, the television said.
The project was due to begin in April and last three years. ($1=125 rials)
